title: LCM 3D Printer
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVAIR.NAVAIR NAWC WD.NAVAL AIR WARFARE CENTER
detail_text: This solicitation amendment 0001 adds clause 252.225-7013 (Duty-Free Entry) in response to a question received during the question period. No additional questions were submitted, and the government now considers the question period closed. This solicitation is for a lithography-based ceramic manufacturing (LCM) multi-material 3D printer in support of current and future capability for ceramic-based composite materials research, development, testing, processing, and production. The LCM 3D printer will produce ceramic composite test articles and small-scale proof of concept parts. This printer shall be a standalone, enclosed printer unit having two interior rotating vats, a route for material dispersion and cleaning, an integrated build platform, an integrated light source, relevant print file preparation software, and integrated GUI controls. For more details, please see the solicitation posting in the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) at the following: https://piee.eb.mil/sol/xhtml/unauth/search/oppMgmtLink.xhtml?noticeId=N6893626Q5096&noticeType=SolicitationNotice Contractors are expected to submit quotes via PIEE to be considered for this requirement.
